swap_risks: CAUTION PACKAGE HEIGHT/PROFILE: AP62200WU-7 (TSOT-23-6) vs TPS562201DDCR (SOT-23-6) share the same JEDEC land pattern pitch, but thin-profile TSOT (~1.0 mm) vs standard SOT (~1.45 mm) differs in body height; verify enclosure Z-clearance, SMT nozzle height, and solder fillet spec.
HIGH VREF MISMATCH: Feedback reference differs (AP62200WU-7: 0.8 V p.5 vs TPS562201DDCR: 0.768 V p.5); dropping in without recalculating R1/R2 will output the wrong voltage rail.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 30% higher on TPS562201DDCR (AP62200WU-7: 70 °C/W p.4 vs TPS562201DDCR: 90.8 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: AP62200WU-7 (Diodes Incorporated, TSOT-23-6) and TPS562201DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-6) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because package code differs (TSOT-23-6 vs SOT-23-6; same land pattern, different body profile); feedback reference voltage Vref differs; θJA worsens 30% (thermal derating verification required). Power-stage deltas: buck (sync) vs buck (sync), switching frequency 750 kHz (p.5) vs 580 kHz (p.5) (1.3x ratio), typical inductor 3.3 µH (p.17) vs 3.3 µH (p.13), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.5) vs 0.768 V (p.5), and package θJA 70 vs 90.8 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP62200WU-7 "CRITICAL: EN Pin Abs Max Is ONLY 8.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V / 18 V VIN!" (p.4) and TPS562201DDCR "Pin-Identical 2 A Sibling of TPS563201DDCR — Verify Current Limit & Inductor Sizing" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose AP62200WU-7 when matching your existing Diodes Incorporated TSOT-23-6 (TSOT26) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TPS562201DDCR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-6 (DDC) qualification and -40..125 °C grade. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
